ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a cube net composed of six squares. The middle row from left to right is U, V, W in order; Y is directly above W; X is directly below V; Z is directly below X. The problem states that these squares are folded along their edges into a cube, and asks to find the face opposite to face X. Reasoning: When folded into a cube using V as the reference face, U and W fold to the left and right side faces of V respectively; X folds up along the lower edge of V, becoming a side face adjacent to V; Z then folds up along the lower edge of X, becoming the face opposite to V. Since Y is connected above W, after W is folded up, Y will continue to fold to the position directly opposite X. Therefore, the face opposite X is Y.

raw_record.question_text: A piece of paper containing six joined squares labeled as shown in the diagram is folded along the edges of the squares to form a cube. What is the label of the face opposite the face labeled $\text{X}$?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a cube net: three squares in a horizontal row labeled U, V, W; Y is attached above W; X is attached below V; Z is attached below X. Use the text to know these six squares are folded along their shared edges to form a cube and the target is the face opposite X. Take V as a reference face. When folded, U and W become opposite side faces, X folds up as one side face adjacent to V, Z folds further to become opposite V, and the square Y attached to W folds around so that it lies on the face directly opposite X. Therefore the opposite face to X is Y.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示一个由六个正方形组成的立方体展开图。中间一行从左到右依次是 U、V、W；Y 在 W 的正上方；X 在 V 的正下方；Z 在 X 的正下方。题目说明这些正方形沿边折叠成一个立方体，要求找出与 X 面相对的面。

推理：以 V 作为参考面折成立方体时，U 和 W 分别折到 V 的左右侧面；X 沿着 V 的下边折起，成为与 V 相邻的一个侧面；Z 再沿着 X 的下边折起，成为与 V 相对的面。由于 Y 连接在 W 的上方，W 折起后，Y 会继续折到与 X 正对的位置。因此，X 的对面是 Y。
